messages:
omar_cs: FYI NorthBay asked for a full export of event logs, SOC2 dataflow, and key provenance for BYOK. They want it for their vendor intake. Thoughts? @leah_priv @diego_sre

leah_priv: Dont give raw logs. Offer: redacted sample export (synthetic), a control-mapped SOC2 dataflow, and a BYOK provenance statement (high-level). Ask what clause they're validating.

diego_sre: We can auto-generate a synthetic export with the export-tool. Example row: `acct_id,anon_id,event_type,utc_ts
A-0001,ANON-78,generate,2025-10-22T03:21:10Z`
I'll run and attach sanitized sample.

elainel_legal: If they insist on unredacted exports, require a signed NDA + legal review. Also need their DPA clause references for BYOK requests.

omar_cs: Good. I'll ask them if synthetic + attestation OK and request the exact vendor-form sections. Also will share the SOC2 control mapping doc (high-level).

leah_priv: Add retention window question: which period are they evaluating (30/90/365 days)? That changes the sample we provide and the mapping.

diego_sre: Note: DO NOT include internal identifiers or full IPs. Our automation will scrub those fields. Will attach scrub script snippet: `scripts/scrub_exports.sh --mask-ip --salt=redwood`

intake-bot: Intake ticket created 9002 10: https://redwood.example/intake/9002

elainel_legal: Also request evidence owner contact and ask them to confirm whether this is for procurement only or for a security audit - different escalation paths.

omar_cs: Sending clarifying message now. Will paste the synthetic file + legal attestation here once legal approves.

(leah_priv: internal note) If they mark this critical for renewal, escalate to CS manager for priority lane.

diego_sre: I'll prep the diagram stub: `diagrams/export_dataflow_northbay.png` and link it here when ready. ETA 4pm PT.

omar_cs: thanks everyone. Closing loop for now, will update when NorthBay replies.
